name: Mopar Engine Oil Filter Kit
description: Engineered to rigorous OEM specifications, the Mopar Engine Oil Filter Kit delivers superior filtration and extended engine protection. Features advanced multi-fiber filter media to trap microscopic contaminants, a durable heat-resistant anti-drainback valve, and precision seal rings for leak-proof installation. Ensures optimal oil circulation and peak engine performance.

name: ACDelco Gold 213-4514 (19236568) Engine Coolant Temperature Sensor
description: The ACDelco Gold Engine Coolant Temperature Sensor provides high-precision thermal monitoring of your vehicle's engine coolant. Relays accurate, real-time operating data to the Engine Control Module (ECM) to optimize fuel delivery, ignition timing, and cooling fan operation. Built with durable brass housing and corrosion-resistant electrical pins for OE-caliber reliability.

name: Fuzzy Leopard Steering Wheel Cover Set
description: Add bold style and year-round comfort to your cabin with this plush leopard print steering wheel cover set. Crafted from high-density, anti-slip microfiber material that shields hands from scorching summer heat and bitter winter chill. The complete 3-piece kit includes a universal steering wheel cover, matching seat belt strap pads, and a gear shift cover.
